summary: Full validation of 'Petito Habla' talking-video feature. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (public slug read, auth gating on POST /talk and /talk/{id}/generate, anonymous /talk/preview with 2/day rate limit, /me/videos lists Rocky, MP checkout returns mercadopago URL). Frontend: 8/8 scenarios pass at 390x844 (landing elements, logged-out /hablar gate, anonymous magic upload -> navigates to /v/<slug> generating state, pre-generated preview /v/0de2b4b5f5 shows video+sound-toggle+line+CTAs, logged-in /hablar wizard advances to voice step with talk-voice-4q0PbHS9CvGUVibwij58, pre-generated /v/23fd33ad28 shows paywall+share-watermark+pay button, pay button navigates to mercadopago.cl, Mis creaciones Videos tab lists Rocky and tabs switch).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1017 POST /talk/preview returns {id,slug} but no mode/status; a client that doesn't immediately navigate to /v/<slug> can't tell if it was a rate-limit soft fail vs. ok. Non-blocking (frontend already navigates on success).

server.py:905 run_talk_pipeline raises RuntimeError('Falta media_base') when media_base is empty. If the Origin header is missing (e.g. server-to-server call), the preview record is created and insta-fails inside the background task. Consider deriving media_base from BRAND_URL or request.base_url as a fallback instead of failing the whole pipeline silently.

/api/me/videos filters mode=full only -- that's correct, but there's no documented GET /api/me/videos endpoint for anonymous preview_free rows (expected; they belong to a device, not a user). Documented for clarity.
frontend/pages/MyCreations.jsx: tab order is now [videos, portraits, stories]; Videos is first/default as spec'd. OK.

frontend/pages/TalkView.jsx: the talk-pay-button triggers window.location.href to MP checkout_url -- works, but there is no loading state for a slow /checkout response (user can double-click). Low priority.
seed_data_creation: Did not seed new DB rows. Used the three pre-generated video rows and the two seeded sessions already in test_database. One ephemeral anonymous preview was triggered through the UI (TEST_FRESH2 device id) to confirm navigation; its DB row stays alongside the three pre-existing public ones but has an auto-expires_at (RETENTION_DAYS) and does not affect any test seeded data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To run anonymous /talk/preview via Playwright, (a) seed a fresh petito_device_id via add_init_script to bypass the 2/day limit, (b) use a REAL image file (>=~1KB, PIL Image.new 512x512 works) because a sub-100-byte PNG triggers HTTPException 400 in storage.save_original. The input[type=file] is CSS-hidden; wait for the sibling button (landing-magic-button) then call set_input_files directly on the locator without visibility check. MP checkout button on /v/23fd33ad28 does a real redirect to https://www.mercadopago.cl/checkout/v1/payment/redirect/... -- do NOT complete payment. After navigating off-site, re-set cookie/localStorage before next test. Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_talk_flow.py is pytest-ready (uses pytest fixtures-less class style, cleans up TEST_ prefixed data).
